sites.title: Hearthspire Keep
sites.description: A home for Malik, Luma and the family you choose. Claim the core, then build your own skyline.

sites.title: Galehook Redoubt
sites.description: Crystal wardens guard a fragment of the Gale lattice. Issue a challenge at the outer sigil. Defeat the defenders, then stand at the core to capture it.

sites.title: Sunscar Bastion
sites.description: A tougher stronghold under the amber crown. Capture the Ember lattice and combine it with Gale at your home core.
